description: Wire vectors of the UnregisterController API (key 94, v0), replayed by tests/Compliance.

vectors.description: UnregisterController request v0 (Kafka 4.4, KIP-1312) on the PLAINTEXT listener, whose `User:ANONYMOUS` is a super user of the `StandardAuthorizer`: the controller id **4242**, which no controller of the node is registered under. The api is flexible from its first version - the request header v2 with its tag buffer, and one more behind the int32.

The **136** `CONTROLLER_ID_NOT_REGISTERED` of Kafka 4.4 with the message of the `ControllerIdNotRegisteredException` of `ClusterControlManager.unregisterController` @ 4.4.0, "Controller ID 4242 is not currently registered.", a compact string of 47 bytes. The broker forwarded the request to the controller of the node, which answered it.

fields.errorMessage: Controller ID 4242 is not currently registered.

vectors.description: The same request for the controller id **-1**.
The **136** again, "Controller ID -1 is not currently registered.": the controller does not check the range of the id, it only looks the registration up.

fields.errorMessage: Controller ID -1 is not currently registered.

vectors.description: The request for the id 4242 on the SASL_PLAINTEXT listener, authenticated as `acltest`, the one principal of the node that is not a super user and holds no acl on the cluster.

The **31** `CLUSTER_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED` of `ControllerApis.handleUnregisterController` @ 4.4.0, which authorizes `ALTER` on the cluster before it looks at the id. Its message is the `toString()` of the request as the controller received it - the forwarded request on the CONTROLLER listener, its connection id and session, and the envelope of the broker around it - followed by "needs ALTER permission.": 560 bytes, whose connection ids and session hashes change with every request.
